overview.text: Today's developments highlight a mix of empirical findings, economic impact, and open-source model releases. A notable study shows that a ten-year-old convolutional neural network outperforms frontier large language models in skin cancer diagnosis. Meanwhile, discussions around labor market impacts note that America has lost a significant number of jobs in media, film, and the arts, while broader macroeconomic reports find no signs of AI payoff outside the tech sector. In academia, a UC Berkeley math professor sees no point in grading homework due to AI usage. On the release front, the Nanbeige/Nanbeige4.3-33B model arrives, proving stronger than Qwen3.8-27B across benchmarks while laying foundations for upcoming small model distillation pipelines. Additionally, ISTA-DASLab/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-GSQ-RCO-GGUF gains traction on Hugging Face, mokevnin/dev-quality-gates curates software standards enforcement tools on GitHub, alignment discussions prepare students for safety debates, and commentary warns of cybersecurity challenges.

entries.title: A 10-year-old CNN outperforms frontier LLMs for skin cancer diagnosis
entries.why: A classic CNN beats frontier LLMs in medical imaging, proving older architectures still hold immense value.

entries.title: America has lost 200k of jobs in media, film and the arts. How much is AI?
entries.why: Examining job losses in creative fields provides crucial data on the actual displacement caused by automation.

entries.title: No signs of AI payoff outside the tech sector
entries.why: The lack of macroeconomic payoffs outside tech challenges current assumptions about enterprise productivity gains.

entries.title: AI use leads UC Berkeley math professor to see 'no point' in grading homework
entries.why: Professors rethinking grading workflows illustrate the immediate disruption AI brings to traditional education and assessment.

entries.title: Nanbeige/Nanbeige4.3-33B · Hugging Face
entries.summary: Stronger than Qwen3.8-27B across a range of benchmarks. but also lays the necessary foundation to power our upcoming small model distillation pipeline (e.g., for Nanbeige4.3-3B). It'll distilled into their 3B small models, maybe other sizes too.
entries.why: This new release offers stronger benchmark performance and sets up an efficient small model distillation pipeline.

entries.title: ISTA-DASLab/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-GSQ-RCO-GGUF
entries.why: This quantized model variant provides the community with another accessible option for local text generation tasks.

entries.title: mokevnin/dev-quality-gates
entries.summary: An opinionated, curated list of tools for enforcing software development standards: one recommended tool per job, with limits. · Python
entries.why: This curated repository helps developers enforce strict quality gates across automated software engineering agent workflows.

entries.title: Setting the Scene (Public v1; October 25)
entries.summary: Context: I created this to share before the start of courses I facilitate to provide a refresher on recent events, but also as a hook to draw students into engaging with some of ideas we think about and debate in AI safety early.
entries.why: Early safety context helps educators hook students into critical debates surrounding artificial intelligence alignment.

entries.title: AI #191: The Hackening Begins
entries.summary: It was the probably worst day in cybersecurity history.
entries.why: Analyzing severe cybersecurity incidents helps researchers anticipate vulnerabilities emerging from automated systems.
